functions.purpose: Boot-time DCO trim from SCU ANATSEMON temperature lookup, write DCOCAL, then unlock SCU PASSWD, program CLKCR (0x3FF10100), wait VDDC stable, relock. Called once at the start of RunRideControlLoop before InitializePeripherals.
Ungate CGATCLR0 bit7, configure POSIF-like module at 0x50010000 (PCONF |= 0x70000010|0x20, offset 0x74=3, PRST=1), set NVIC IPR/ISER for IRQ 27 (POSIF0_0).
USIC-init copy of SetNvicIrqPriority: write Cortex-M0 2-bit priority into NVIC IPR (or SCB SHPR for negative IRQ numbers). Called with IRQ 9 priority 3.
Ungate USIC0 (CGAT bit3), rewrite CLKCR, configure USIC CH1 at 0x48000200 (BRG/INPR/DX0CR/PCR/PSCR/FIFO), set P0.6 alt output, then priority/clear/enable IRQ 9 (USIC0_0).
Same clock ungate, configure USIC CH0 at 0x48000000 (ASCII UART PCR/DX/FIFO), PORT2 pad/IOCR, then IRQ 9 priority/clear/enable. Companion to channel-1 display UART.
Checksum 24-byte display TX buffer (sum bytes 0-7 at [8], sum bytes 9-22 at [23]), then push 24 bytes into USIC CH1 TX FIFO IN[0].
Walk 0-8 index, fill 6-byte aux frame from two flash LUTs plus checksum (lutA+lutB+0x5D), push to USIC CH0 TX FIFO.
USIC-init copy of NVIC ISER write: enable IRQ n if n>=0. Used for USIC IRQ 9.
Write NVIC ICPR (0xE000E280) to clear pending IRQ n if n>=0. Called before enabling USIC IRQ 9.
12-bit VADC temp-bank result at +0x1c. Ride loop averages 4 samples into assist current targeting (offset 600, map to ride-state+0x12).
12-bit VADC temp-bank result at +0x14. Consumed by UpdateAuxAdcSlewLevel (threshold 0x19A).
12-bit VADC temp-bank result at +0x18. Consumed by UpdateBatteryCurrentLimit (16-sample average, overcurrent flags).
